 About Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales
 Experience a new way to explore Orange Beach
 

 
 
 
 

 
 Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales is a local family owned business that loves the water! We offer a fun and unique way to enjoy the waters of Orange Beach. Our portable-eco friendly electric circle boats make it easy for anyone to be a captain! Quiet, clean, and simple to operate, they're perfect for cruising in the no wake zones, fishing through the canals, pull up to one of islands for a relaxing day or stopping at one of the local waterfront restaurants for lunch or appetizers! Its a laid back experience the whole family can enjoy and a memory you'll never forget!
 
 Perfect For: Perfect for families, couples, birthday parties, group outings, fishing trips, or simply relaxing on the water. No boating license needed!
 
 Eco-FriendlyZero emissions, zero noise pollution. 35lb thrust electric motors.Stable & SafeDesigned with a low center of gravity for smooth, stable ride. Life jackets are included and no license required or experience needed.Highly stable due to its 360-degree circular, inflatable design, which acts like a bumper boat, making it virtually untippable and easy to stand on and capable of handling waves from any direction.PortableInflatable design. Portable, everything you need in a backpack! We can bring boats to your private dock or event.Gulf Coast ViewsExplore Orange Beach waterways like never before!EventsBirthdays, date nights, bachelor parties, team outings.

 FAQ
 Frequently Asked Questions
 Everything you need to know before booking.
 
 WHAT SHOULD I BRING?▸Just bring your beach-day essentials: Sunscreen, beach towels, cooler with your favorite drinks and snacks, whatever you'd bring for a perfect day on the water!
Want to go a little extra? You're welcome to bring chairs and large coolers, but we recommend renting one of our floating docks that attaches to your boat. It gives you extra room to spread out, float, and tie up with friends.
Pro tip: The chair on your Circle Boat pops right off and works great as a beach chair when you stop at the island. Pretty handy right?DO YOU DELIVER THE CIRCLE BOAT TO ME?▸Most of our guest meet us at one of our launch locations, where we'll have your boat in the water and give you a quick safety rundown before you head out to explore.
You can launch from locations in :
*Orange Beach
*Gulf Shores.
Staying at a water front vacation rental? We may be able to deliver directly to you--as long as your location if in a safe boating area like no-wake zones or lake.
If it's safe, we'll bring the fun straight to your dock. Easy as that!WHERE DO YOU LAUNCH?▸ORANGE BEACH
Romar Marina
26350 Cotton Bayou Dr.
Orange Beach, AL
Book 9am-1pm or 2pm-6pm or all day 9am-6pm

GULF SHORES
GALLEY ON THE RIVER (Bon Secur River)
18546 County Road 10
Half -day trips onlyCAN I USE MY CIRCLE BOAT IN THE GULF?▸That's a hard NO.
Our Circle Boats are designed for calm protected water, not Gulf waves or currents. The Gulf can get rough, and our trolling motors prefer a more relaxed beach vibe.WHERE CAN I RIDE MY CIRCLE BOAT?▸No wake zones are the sweet spot.
Around Orange Beach you'll find gorgeous little islands with white sandy beaches, calm water, and even a few waterfront bars and restaurants you can pull right up to.
We'll give you a waterproof map that shows the best spots to explore, float, beach your boat, and enjoy the day safely. Island hopping+floating with your crew=best beach day ever!HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?▸Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated no-wake areas, and keep the the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?▸Nope---that's the beauty of it.
* You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?▸First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you. often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?▸Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the waterHOW MANY PEOPLE FIT ON A CIRCLE BOAT?▸One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!
